description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'UserCustomData' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Schema for per-player custom data fields — name, type, default value, visibility, whether the client can write it. This is the SCHEMA only; actual per-user values live on the User document. Use this to declare new player-specific stats, flags, or progress counters.

x-enum-descriptions: Visible only to the owner. Client can read and write. Examples: personal UI settings, tutorial progress, local preferences.
Visible to the owner and to any other player via cross-user endpoints. Client can read and write its own. Examples: custom title, bio string, avatar frame color, badges.
Visible only to the owner. Client can read but cannot write; only the server writes into this bucket. Examples: tutorial progress, server-side feature flags, A/B variants.
Never returned to the client. Server jobs / admin / analytics only. Cross-user endpoints do not see this bucket. Examples: anti-cheat marks, risk score, segmentation metadata.
Arbitrary string. Validated by length only.
Integer. Must parse as long via long.TryParse. Returned to the client as a string.
Boolean. Must be "true" or "false" (case-insensitive, via bool.TryParse).
Valid JSON document. Any structure parseable via JToken.Parse. Size limited by MaxValueLengthBytes.

UserCustomDataKeyDefinition.description: Description of a single registered (schema-managed) Custom User Data V2 key. Defines a fixed Bucket and validation rules (ValueType / MaxValueLengthBytes / TtlSeconds) applied on every write.

Bucket.description: Bucket where the record will physically reside. Defines both privacy (who reads) and writability (who writes). Fixed at config level; client cannot move the key between buckets.

DefaultValue.description: Default value returned by the API when no record with this KeyID exists or it has expired. null means absent keys are returned as absent. Default is used on read only; not materialized in the DB until an explicit write.

Description.description: Developer-facing description of the key's purpose for documentation. Not returned to the client in Get* operations and does not affect validation.

KeyID.description: Unique identifier of the key across all buckets. Matches the key in UserCustomDataDefinitions.Keys and in the corresponding bucket dictionary. Must not contain '.' or '$'.

MaxValueLengthBytes.description: Hard size limit of UserCustomDataRecord.Value in bytes (UTF-8) for this key. Overrides UserCustomDataDefinitions.DefaultMaxValueLengthBytes. Writes exceeding the limit are rejected before the DB patch.

TtlSeconds.description: Key TTL in seconds. null means no TTL (permanent record). When set, every write computes ExpiresAt = now + TtlSeconds. Expired records are filtered on read and atomically purged on next write to the same bucket.

ValueType.description: Expected format of UserCustomDataRecord.Value: String (arbitrary), Int (long.TryParse), Bool ("true"/"false"), or Json (valid JSON document). Validated by server before the DB patch.

value.description: Configuration of the Custom User Data V2 system (arbitrary user records). Hybrid architecture combining bucket-based privacy separation (Private/Public/ReadOnly/Internal) with optional typed key schema.

DefaultMaxValueLengthBytes.description: Default size limit of UserCustomDataRecord.Value in bytes (UTF-8). Applied to unregistered keys when RejectUnregisteredKeys = false. Registered keys use their own MaxValueLengthBytes. Recommended: 8192 (8 KB).

DefaultTtlSeconds.description: Default TTL for unregistered keys, in seconds. null means no TTL (permanent). When set, free-form writes get ExpiresAt = now + DefaultTtlSeconds. Registered keys use their own TtlSeconds.

Keys.description: Schema-managed keys. Dictionary key is UserCustomDataKeyDefinition.KeyID. Writes to these keys are validated against the schema (Bucket / ValueType / MaxValueLengthBytes / TtlSeconds). Unregistered keys are either treated as free-form or rejected based on RejectUnregisteredKeys.

MaxKeysPerBucket.description: Maximum number of keys allowed per bucket (applied uniformly to Private/Public/ReadOnly/Internal). Protects against unbounded dictionary growth in the bson document. Recommended: 128.

MaxTotalSizeBytes.description: Total size limit of all Custom User Data V2 per player across all four buckets, in bytes. Protects against MongoDB's 16 MB bson document limit. Recommended: 1,500,000 (~1.5 MB).

RejectUnregisteredKeys.description: If true, writes to unregistered keys are rejected (strict schema mode). If false, unregistered keys are accepted as free-form with default limits. Default: false.
